mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_turn (turn_id, case_id, session_id, actor_id, turn_type, attempt_no, input_summary, output_summary, status, checkpoint_before, checkpoint_after, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{turnId}, #{caseId}, #{sessionId}, #{actorId}, #{turnType}, #{attemptNo}, #{inputSummary}, #{outputSummary}, #{status}, #{checkpointBefore}, #{checkpointAfter}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_turn SET output_summary = #{outputSummary}, status = #{status}, checkpoint_after = #{checkpointAfter}, end_time = #{endTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE turn_id = #{turnId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_turn WHERE case_id = #{caseId}
